description: Open the 'Vector Drawing' activity in GCompris (found in the 'Computer Discovery' or 'Experimental' category, icon looks like a drawing tool/nodes). Create a digital drawing consisting of a House and a Sun. The House must have a square/rectangular body and a triangular roof. The Sun should be a circle in the sky. Use at least two different colors in your drawing. Once finished, take a screenshot of your artwork and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/drawing_composition.png' using the system screenshot tool.
